summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a share buyback transaction on May 18, 2026, purchasing 15,675,080 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 94.8085 pence per share. The shares were bought from Goldman Sachs International under an existing buyback programme announced on January 30, 2026. The company intends to cancel the purchased shares. This is an open-market repurchase programme, a capital return to shareholders. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for updates on programme completion and share cancellation impact on earnings per share. Risk-arb: low, as it's a routine buyback execution.
